meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 多了两个工具：能列出 Atomic Chat 中已下载的本地模型，也能把问题发给指定模型并返回回答。Claude 仍是主导，可把部分任务交给本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 使用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型来完成任务时，例如说“用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都”。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 列出当前可用的模型
say.note: Claude 会调用列表工具，显示模型 ID。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会选择模型并生成回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains two tools: listing local models available in Atomic Chat, and sending prompts to a chosen model to get a response. Claude remains the orchestrator and can offload tasks to local models.
howto.when_en: When the user asks Claude to use Atomic Chat or a local model for a task, e.g., "use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France".

say_en.text: List the models currently available in atomic chat.
say_en.note: Claude calls the list tool and shows model IDs.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude picks a model and generates a reply.

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate with qwen2.5-coder to write a sort function.
say_en.note: Replace with an actual model ID.
